title: Flooding Weather Four Corners
report:

The flooding has caused significant damage, with over 100 homes and RVs damaged in southern Utah, and governors from the affected states have declared disaster emergencies. title: Arc Browser Sunsets December 22 As The Browser Company Doubles Down On Dia
report:
**Summary (4 sentences)**

The Browser Company is discontinuing its Arc browser, citing rising security costs in the age of AI, and will instead focus on its AI-first browser, Dia. The shutdown will occur in three stages, with new Arc accounts no longer being created, AI features being removed from Arc Search on November 23, and the browser ceasing to function entirely on December 22. Despite user disappointment, The Browser Company has ruled out open-sourcing Arc due to its reliance on the proprietary Arc Development Kit (ADK). Users will be able to transfer key features, including passwords and bookmarks, to Dia, which will offer AI-powered features as an optional upgrade.

**Key Facts (5)**

1. The Browser Company is sunsetting its Arc browser on December 22, 2026, due to rising security costs in the age of AI.
2. The shutdown will occur in three stages, with new Arc accounts no longer being created, AI features being removed from Arc Search on November 23, and the browser ceasing to function entirely on December 22.
3. The Browser Company has ruled out open-sourcing Arc due to its reliance on the proprietary Arc Development Kit (ADK), which is also used to power its Dia browser.
4. Key features from Arc, including passwords, bookmarks, and extensions, will be transferable to Dia, which will offer AI-powered features as an optional upgrade.
5. The Browser Company acquired by Atlassian for $610 million in 2025, and Arc's shutdown marks the end of a chapter that began when the startup stopped active feature development on the browser in 2025.
